output.answer_markdown: PepsiCo raised its full-year 2023 guidance because of a strong start to the year, according to management. CEO Ramon Laguarta tied the higher outlook to the first-quarter performance [1]. He also credited the start to categories and geographies that remained resilient during the first quarter [2]. The passages do not quantify how much each factor contributed.
